title: Style sample: news-brief
objective: Show what a news-brief film looks like: one object that changes state, and every claim drawn with how sure it is.
audience: The Motion Lab team, reviewing what each style template looks like before using it.

message.core_message: A fire at Korea's NIRS data center took 647 government systems offline; most came back from backups, one shared drive did not.
key_points: States what happened, where and when.
Gives the scale: how many systems stopped.
Closes on what was lost and where it comes from.

constraints: Silent: no narration, music or effects; the picture carries it.
Built to style template news-brief v2; scene roles follow its scene grammar.

research.reason: Style sample for look review. Facts reuse the dossier in projects/south-korea-data-center-fire/research.json (Yonhap, Korea Times).

creative_directions.name: news-brief template
creative_directions.concept: A 22-second walk through the news-brief template's scene grammar on a subject that fits its visual job: A data center fire, in one grid.

composition.approach: Portrait only: copy in the top band, the hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

creative_directions.pacing: A planned visual event at least every 2 seconds.
creative_directions.why_it_fits: It is the template's own grammar, so the sample shows the template rather than one film's choices.

success_criteria: Each scene role of the template is recognisable
No frame holds still for more than 2.5 s
